records.name: Olde Richmond Civic Association
records.summary: If you care about what gets built near you, Olde Richmond Civic Association is a City registered community organization in the River Wards part of the city that hears about zoning and development proposals.
records.what_you_do: Members follow zoning and development plans in the area and meet to talk them over.

locations.label: Meeting place
locations.address: Cione Recreation Center, 2600 E. Aramingo Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19125

first_step.how: Email Mike Cunningham at Mdcphilly@gmail.com or call (215) 518-0591 and ask when the next meeting on zoning and development is held and where.
first_step.basis: The only public page we could open is a Facebook page that showed just its name without logging in, so the way in is unclear. The City list gives a contact name, an email, and a phone number.
first_step.what_to_expect: We could not find a public description of a meeting, so we do not know how long it runs or who comes. Ask the contact what the next meeting will cover before you go.
first_visit_tips: Ask for the meeting date, time, and room before you go.
If a nearby project is on your mind, bring its address so you can ask about it.

records.name: Philadelphia Women's Theatre Festival
records.summary: A two-week festival held in August that shows plays and performances by local women, with a panel, a monologue night, and an industry brunch. Auditions for each festival are posted on its website.
records.what_you_do: Audition for a festival production, volunteer to usher or help with set up and take down, or buy tickets and attend the shows.

schedule.text: A two-week festival every August, with shows, a panel, and an industry brunch. The site does not give exact days.

cost.text: Festival tickets are sold online through the group's ticket page. The site does not list prices.

first_step.how: Email autumn@phillywomenstheatrefest.org with the subject Volunteer Opportunities to offer to usher or help with set up and take down.
first_step.basis: The site says it always needs volunteers and gives one email address to ask, so the way in is clear. It names no beginner program or orientation, so it is rated 3.
first_step.what_to_expect: Volunteers help with ushering, set up, and take down for the festival. The site does not say how long a shift runs or what time it starts, so ask when you send your email. To see a show, you buy a ticket online first.
first_visit_tips: Use the subject line Volunteer Opportunities so your email is easy to find.
Ask for the shift time, the place, and how long it lasts before you say yes.
Join the email list on the site to hear when the next audition call opens.

records.notes: Read today: home, join-our-team, audition, contact and programs pages. The audition page is for one 2026 production (Stella for Star, per the page) whose video deadline in June has passed, so auditions are closed. That page also lists paid roles, with stipends of $750 to $975 as the page states; left out of the record because the call is closed. Email routes: volunteers to autumn@, general questions to margaux@, play submissions and audition form problems to glynnis@. No venue address, phone number, ticket price or accessibility detail is published. The programs page only links to older (2024) material. Tier 1 listed the same IRS mailing address twice; one kept. The rehearsal and show venues named on the audition page belong to that one production, so they are not listed as festival venues.

records.name: Community Schools @South Philadelphia High School
records.summary: A Community School partnership between the City, the School District and neighbors, South Philadelphia High School welcomes volunteers through the City's volunteer portal.
records.what_you_do: Hand out weekly groceries to students and families, spend time with students in the gaming room, and help at special events such as resource fairs.

first_step.how: Email Madeline Cerulli at Madeline.Cerulli@phila.gov to ask about open shifts, then start the clearance checks before your first shift.
first_step.basis: Volunteers must finish background clearances and have the principal certify their code of conduct before they start, so you cannot just show up. The contact route is clear, so the way in is at least open.
first_step.what_to_expect: Expect paperwork first: the clearance checks, a short orientation (about 45 minutes, online or in person), and a signed code of conduct that the principal certifies. The listing says volunteers help with groceries, the gaming room, and special events, but it does not say how long a shift lasts.
first_visit_tips: Ask the school's Family Engagement Liaison for the Volunteer Checklist, since the district says the liaison helps with the forms.
The child abuse and state criminal checks are free, and the child abuse result arrives by email within 14 days, so start early.
If you have not lived in Pennsylvania for the past 10 years, book a fingerprint check through IdentoGo first ($23.25, and you must pre-enroll).

records.name: Community Schools @Southwark School
records.summary: Southwark School is one of the City's Community Schools, where volunteers help with after school and family programs. Open shifts are listed on the City's volunteer portal.
records.what_you_do: Hand out weekly groceries to students and families, help run the food and clothing pantry, and help at community fairs and other special events.

access.notes: The school says families can ask for translation or accessibility accommodations for school events.

first_step.how: Email Madeline Cerulli at Madeline.Cerulli@phila.gov to ask about open shifts, then start the clearance checks before your first shift.
first_step.basis: Volunteers must finish background clearances and have the principal certify their code of conduct before they start, so you cannot just show up. The contact route is clear, so the way in is at least open.
first_step.what_to_expect: Expect paperwork first: the clearance checks, a short orientation (about 45 minutes, online or in person), and a signed code of conduct that the principal certifies. The school day runs from 9:00 am to 3:39 pm, and the listing does not say how long a shift lasts.
first_visit_tips: Ask the school's Family Engagement Liaison for the Volunteer Checklist, since the district says the liaison helps with the forms.
The child abuse and state criminal checks are free, and the child abuse result arrives by email within 14 days, so start early.
The school's advisory council meets on the third Monday of each month at 9:15 am in the auditorium, and the school says all are welcome. It is a way to see the building before you volunteer.
